# Duplicates {#sec-duplicates}

::: {.pkgs}
Packages: `janitor` `dplyr`
:::

Duplicate participant IDs can mean a participant submitted twice, a data entry error, or sometimes a genuine repeated-measures row — check before deleting.

```r
library(janitor)

# see the actual duplicate rows
survey_raw |> get_dupes(participant_id)

library(dplyr)
# keep only the first occurrence of each ID
survey_raw <- survey_raw |> distinct(participant_id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

::: {.callout-tip}
Investigate *why* a duplicate exists before deleting it — it might be a legitimate second session, not an error.
:::
